problem_statement: The Ferment Journal is a small-batch fermentation and preserving journal built on the AstroPaper Astro theme (a homepage 'Recent Posts' list, article pages, a tag index and tag-detail routes, an archive listing, Pagefind search and an About page, all under a shared Header/Footer). Odette Brine wants two connected things. First, a topic filter sitting directly above the Recent Posts list on the home page: a labelled row of topic tabs (All topics / Brine / Culture / Cellar / Ferment-notes) plus a live readout that reads 'Showing N of M · <topic>'; clicking a tab must filter the post cards to that topic and update the count. Second, a small 'Journal topics' rail in the footer that should appear on every reading surface so a reader always sees the strands the journal covers. Ship these so they (1) place the topic filter above the Recent Posts grid and the topics rail in the footer of the home, tags, About, archive and article pages alike, (2) lay the tab row out responsively without horizontal overflow on a phone, (3) match the journal's quiet editorial styling (dashed accent tabs keyed to the theme tokens, legible active tab, non-overlapping cards) rather than an off-palette slab or a broken overlapping layout, and (4) keep the filter live so clicking a topic tab actually hides the non-matching post cards and rewrites the readout to the real shown/total count. Keep the rest of the theme — navigation, existing content, Pagefind search, RSS, the Astro build — intact with no console or network errors.
required_content: Add a topic filter directly above the home page's Recent Posts list: a 'Filter the journal by topic' label, a tab row (All topics, Brine, Culture, Cellar, Ferment-notes), and a 'Showing N of M · <topic>' readout.
Add a shared 'Journal topics' rail to the site footer so it renders on the home, tags, About, archive and article pages (a shared component invoked from Footer.astro, not a per-page copy).
The tab row must wrap responsively so no reading surface overflows horizontally on a 390px phone (overflow tolerance 24px).

Style the filter in the journal's quiet editorial language (dashed accent tabs keyed to the theme tokens, a legible active tab, and post cards that keep their normal spacing) — not an off-palette gray slab and not overlapping/shingled cards.

Wire the filter so clicking a topic tab hides the non-matching post cards and rewrites the readout to the true 'Showing N of M · <topic>' count — it must re-read the live card list, not replay a captured 'Showing all' snapshot.
Preserve navigation (Home/Posts/Tags/About/Archives/Search), the footer, the existing article/tag/archive/search content and the Astro build with no console or network errors.
design_constraints: Implement the topics rail as a shared component rendered from the footer so a single source of truth reaches every page; do not paste divergent copies per page or gate it to only some routes.
The topic-tab row must use a fluid, wrapping layout (no fixed-width nowrap track) so it never forces horizontal overflow on tablet or mobile.

The filter must adopt the AstroPaper theme tokens (accent, border, muted) and the dashed-tab idiom so it reads as part of the journal, with an active tab that stays legible and post cards that never overlap.
The filter must reflect the true post list after every tab click by re-reading the live cards, so the shown-count and the visible cards can never go stale relative to the selected topic.
Do not remove or regress the navigation, existing content, Pagefind search, RSS or the Astro build.

change_completion: The topic filter is present above the Recent Posts list on the home page, and the 'Journal topics' rail is present in the footer of the home, tags, About, archive and article pages (the shared component reaches all routes).

After clicking the Brine tab on the home page, the readout updates to 'Showing 2 of 7 · Brine' and only the two Brine post cards remain visible — the post-interaction terminal state changed from 'Showing 7 of 7 · All topics'.
design_consistency: The topic filter and post cards on the home Recent-Posts state match the reference's editorial styling under the visual-regression gate (pixel/ssim/block-fidelity), not an off-palette gray slab or an overlapping card layout.
The filter adopts the AstroPaper theme tokens and dashed-tab idiom with a legible active tab so it reads as part of the journal.
responsive: No captured reading surface overflows horizontally beyond 24px on a 390px phone; the tab row wraps.
desktop_recent and mobile_recent keep the topic filter and post cards readable across viewports without clipping or overflow.
regression: Navigation (Home/Posts/Tags/About/Archives/Search), the footer, and Pagefind search remain present and functional.
The existing article/tag/archive/search content, tag routing, archive grouping, RSS and the Astro build are not removed or broken, with no console or network errors.

state_constraints: desktop_initial, tablet_initial and mobile_initial protect the rebranded homepage and responsive shell.

desktop_tags, mobile_tags, desktop_tag_brine, desktop_archives, desktop_post_top, desktop_second_post, desktop_search and desktop_about protect the existing reading surfaces and carry the Journal-topics rail in the footer.
desktop_recent and mobile_recent scroll the topic filter and Recent Posts grid into view and must show the editorial filter without horizontal overflow or overlapping cards.
desktop_topic_filter clicks the Brine tab; the readout must then read 'Showing 2 of 7 · Brine' with only the Brine cards visible.
author_notes: slot_234 L4 dedup + hardening of the AstroPaper 'Ferment Journal' rebrand (moved off the shared 11ty eleventy-base-blog repo onto the fresh satnaing/astro-paper theme). The full rebrand content — the Ferment Journal wordmark, the seven fermentation posts, the About body, the brine/culture/cellar/notes tags — is shared byte-identically across legs; the L4 levers ride on the new topic filter above the Recent Posts list plus a shared 'Journal topics' footer rail. reference = filter above the grid with a fluid wrapping tab row, editorial dashed-tab styling, correct live filtering, and the rail on every page (passes D2/D3/D4/D6). baseline = the original unrepaired build: the rail present on the home page only (fails D2 cross-page), a fixed 640px nowrap tab row (fails D6 mobile overflow), a plain off-brand gray slab (fails D3), but its filter JS is correct so clicking Brine still shows 'Showing 2 of 7 · Brine' (passes D4). bad = a 'smart wrong' build: the rail on home+tags only (fails D2 about/post/archive), a 560px nowrap tab row 'fixed' with an inner overflow-x:hidden (fails D6), an illegible near-white active tab over shingled, negatively margined post cards that overlap (fails D3), and a filter whose click toggles the active tab but replays a captured 'Showing 7 of 7 · All topics' snapshot so no cards hide (fails D4) — bad fails 4 orthogonal gates. Native lever, real fermentation-journal genre, verdigris-free editorial imagery of jars and cellar shelves in the post set.
